officialText:
Section 700.6 – Revise the opening paragraph of Section 700.6 to read as follows:

700.6 Signals. Where required by the New York City Building Code, audible and visual signal devices shall be provided, for the purposes described in 700.6(A) through (D) and shall announce at a constantly attended location.
